messages.Minderjährige sollten keine sensiblen Da: Minors should not publish sensitive data, private addresses, or images of other people without consent.
messages.Missbrauch von Vereins- oder Teamverwalt: Misuse of club or team management functions, such as incorrect payment markings, unfounded warnings, pressure on members, or publication of internal contribution data.
messages.Mit Auftragsverarbeitern werden Verträge: Contracts are concluded with processors in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR.
messages.Mit dem Hochladen räumen Nutzer Airmius: By uploading, users grant Airmius the rights necessary for advertising, storage, technical processing, and provision within the platform.
messages.Moderations- und Sicherheitsdaten können: Moderation and security data can be retained for longer periods to ensure traceability and prevent misuse.
messages.Moderatoren prüfen Meldungen und können: Moderators review reports and can remove content or restrict accounts.
messages.Nach Zustimmung bleibt die Eltern-E-Mail: After consent, the parent email is retained as long as the child is under 16 years old and storage is required for consent, revocation, or traceability.
messages.Nach dem Widerruf werden neue personalis: After revocation, new personalized ad and conversion signals are no longer processed. Necessary cookies for login, cart, security, and CSRF protection remain active.
messages.Nicht erlaubt sind Werbung für verbotene: Permitted advertising is not allowed for prohibited, harmful to minors, discriminatory, misleading, or unlawful content.
messages.Nutze die Meldefunktion bei Posts, Komme: Use the reporting function for posts, comments, and chat messages.
messages.Nutze zuerst die Passwort-zurücksetzen-F: First use the password reset function. If you still cannot log in, send your account deletion request from the email address of the affected account
messages.Nutzer bleiben für ihre Beiträge, Kommen: Users remain responsible for their posts, comments, chats, images, files, and profile information.
messages.Nutzer dürfen Sportplätze, Bilder und Or: Users may only enter sports facilities, images, and location information if they were lawfully obtained and do not infringe the rights of third parties.
messages.Nutzer dürfen keine Bilder, Gesundheitsd: Users may not transmit images, health data, or personal data of others to AI functions without the necessary authorization or consent.
messages.Nutzer dürfen nur Inhalte hochladen, für: Users may only upload content for which they hold the necessary rights and consents.
messages.Nutzer können Inhalte melden und Entsche: Users may report content and request decisions regarding support.
messages.Nutzer können ihr Konto nach den verfügb: Users may delete their account using the available platform functions or request deletion via support.
messages.Nutzer können ihre eigenen Rechnungen un: Users may view their own invoices and payments marked as paid in their profile or settings section.
messages.Nutzer müssen bei der Registrierung rich: Users must provide accurate and up-to-date information during registration.
messages.Nutzer unter 16 Jahren benötigen für soz: Users under 16 years of age require consent from an authorized guardian for social features.
messages.Nutzer unter 16 Jahren können soziale Fu: Users under 16 years of age may only use social features if an authorized guardian consents.
messages.Nutzer, Vereine, Sponsoren oder Anbieter: Users, clubs, sponsors, or providers may submit marketplace offers such as products, courses, camps, or services for review.
messages.Offizielle Vereine müssen ihre Vereinsnu: Official clubs must provide their club number. Membership numbers may be manually entered by the club or generated by the platform.
messages.Ohne Einwilligung speichert Airmius kein: Airmius does not store personalized retargeting signals or associate ad clicks with future registrations or purchases without consent.
messages.Ohne Zustimmung bleiben soziale Funktion: Social features remain limited without consent.
messages.Optional können Erziehungsberechtigte ei: Optional: Educators can create their own Airmius parent account or link an existing account.
messages.Organisation von Vereinen, Teams, Traini: Organizing clubs, teams, training sessions, events, chats, and files.
messages.Personalisierte Anzeigen, Retargeting un: Personalized ads, retargeting, and conversion tracking are only activated when you explicitly allow them in your privacy settings.
messages.Personalisierte Ausspielung von Anzeigen: Personalized ad delivery and retargeting are only enabled after the logged-in user has given consent.
messages.Personalisierte Werbung, Retargeting, Co: Personalized advertising, retargeting, conversion tracking, external pixels, or cross-site tracking are only used if you have previously given consent.
messages.Profil- und Plattformdaten: Profilfoto,: Profile and platform data: Profile picture, biography, sports, skills, sports licenses, teams, clubs, friendships, recommendations, gamification data, and settings.
messages.Rechnungen, Zahlungen, Abonnements, offe: Invoices, payments, subscriptions, open orders, shipping and return transactions, as well as other records may be retained longer due to legal retention obligations, contract fulfillment, misuse prevention, or legitimate interests.
messages.Rechnungs-, Zahlungs- und Beitragsdaten: Invoices, payment, and contribution data may be retained longer due to commercial, tax, or club legal retention and record-keeping obligations.
messages.Rechnungs-, Zahlungs-, Bestell-, Vereins: Invoices, payment, order, club, and record data may be retained longer as long as legal retention obligations, contract evidence, tax obligations, misuse prevention, or legitimate interests apply.
messages.Registrierungsdaten: Vorname, Nachname,: Registration data: First name, last name, email address, password, date of birth, country and optionally address data.
messages.Respekt, Fairness und Schutz der Privats: Respect, fairness, and privacy protection apply in feeds, chats, profiles, files, events, and recommendations.
messages.Rohbilder für KI-Analysen werden grundsä: Raw images for AI analysis are generally not permanently stored when the feature is set to temporary processing. Confirmed meals, drink volumes, training data, routes, tracks, or sports facilities remain stored until the user deletes them or legal or legitimate reasons apply.
messages.Sexuelle Inhalte, sexualisierte Ansprach: Sexual content, sexualized communication, or exploitation, especially towards minors.
messages.Sicherheit, Missbrauchsvermeidung, Moder: Security, abuse prevention, moderation, and enforcement of community rules.
messages.Sie kann auch für kostenpflichtige Add-o: It may also be relevant for paid add-ons, marketplace purchases, digital content, advertising agency or website services, or comparable distance sales contracts.
messages.Solange Airmius ausschließlich kostenlos: As long as Airmius is used exclusively for free, this page can serve as a precautionary consumer information.
messages.Soweit die Verarbeitung auf Einwilligung: Where processing is based on consent, you may revoke this consent with effect from the future.
messages.Soweit möglich wird die Konfiguration au: To the extent possible, the configuration is aligned with European data storage and GDPR-compliant processing. A binding assurance that all Cloudflare data and metadata remain exclusively within the EU exists only if appropriate Cloudflare data localization functions such as Regional Services, Metadata Boundary, or Geo Key Manager are actually booked and activated.
messages.Soweit optionale Cookies oder einwilligu: Where optional cookies or consent-required advertising and analytics functions are used, you may revoke your consent at any time through the cookie settings or in the privacy settings.
messages.Spam, Betrug, Phishing, manipulatives Ve: Spam, fraud, phishing, manipulative behavior, and unauthorized advertising.
messages.Sportkarte, Routenplanung, Tracking und: Sports maps, route planning, tracking, and sports facility functions serve for planning and documentation of athletic activities. They do not replace personal verification of the environment, traffic rules, terrain, weather conditions, or personal performance capabilities.
messages.Sportkarten- und Routendaten: Startpunkt: Sports map and route data: Start points, end points, waypoints, track points, sports facilities, uploaded sports facility images, geographical coordinates, optional browser location data, as well as calculated route and distance data.
messages.Sportler können ihre sportliche Lizenznu: Athletes can self-register their sports license number. Clubs can view this number for association or team management purposes, if required.
messages.Stand: 25.05.2026. KI-, Karten-, Routing: Last updated: 25.05.2026. AI, mapping, routing, nutrition and tracking features have been added. Please store the current AVV/DPA documents for the providers actually used internally and have the texts legally reviewed before going live.
messages.Standort-, Track- und Routingdaten werde: Location, track, and routing data are only stored when the user saves, publishes, or associates them with a training, sports facility, or track. Pure preview or calculation data is kept as briefly as possible.
messages.Standortzugriff und Live-Tracking werden: Location access and live tracking are only used when the user grants permission in the browser or device. The user can revoke this permission at any time through browser or device settings.
messages.Technische Daten: IP-Adresse, Browserdat: Technical data: IP address, browser data, log data, session data, language, time zone, and security events.
messages.Trainings-, Ernährungs- und Trinkdaten:: Training, nutrition, and hydration data: training plans, units, logs, exercises, sets, sport type, duration, distance, intensity, meals, food items, nutritional values, fluid intake, goals, and progress metrics.
messages.Um das Widerrufsrecht auszuüben, musst d: To exercise your right of revocation, you must inform Airmius with a clear and unambiguous statement.
messages.Verantwortlich für die Verarbeitung pers: Data processor responsible for personal data processing is:
messages.Verboten ist auch die Veröffentlichung f: It is also prohibited to publish foreign images or personal data without necessary consent.
messages.Verboten ist auch die missbräuchliche Nu: It is also prohibited to misuse the club management, especially false membership data, incorrect payment markings, unfounded demands, or using membership data for harassment or intimidation.
messages.Verboten ist die Nutzung von KI-, Karten: It is prohibited to use AI, map, routing, or tracking functions for monitoring, harassment, deception, endangerment, or unlawful processing of data of other persons.
messages.Verboten sind Werbekampagnen, die Nutzer: It is prohibited to run marketing campaigns that deceive users, improperly target minors, or violate youth protection, data privacy, competition law, or platform rules.
messages.Verboten sind insbesondere Beleidigungen: It is prohibited to engage in insults, bullying, hate speech, threats, sexual content directed at minors, calls for violence, spam, fraud, or unlawful content.
messages.Verboten sind irreführende Marketplace-A: It is prohibited to use misleading marketplace offers, fake offers, counterfeit reviews, prohibited products, rights violations, or circumventing the Airmius commission and payment logic.
messages.Verbraucher haben grundsätzlich das Rech: Consumers generally have the right to cancel a distance contract within 14 days without giving a reason.
messages.Vereine können Airmius als Werbeagentur: Associations can request Airmius as a marketing agency to create or prepare a club website, landing page, or digital campaign.
messages.Vereine können Personen auch zunächst nu: Associations can initially only collect individuals via email as external members. A connection with an Airmius account is established only when the association activates the invitation/link and an appropriate account exists or the invited person creates an account.
messages.Vereine können zudem Mitgliedschaften, T: Associations can manage memberships, team affiliations, and contribution/invoice information as necessary for the respective association.
messages.Vereine und Teams können innerhalb von A: Associations and teams can be managed within Airmius. Authorized club administrators can accept or reject team membership requests.
messages.Vereins-, Team- und Berechtigungszuordnu: Club, team, and permission assignments are not automatically removed through partial data deletion to prevent data loss of other persons or organizations.
messages.Vereinsverantwortliche sind für die Rich: Club administrators are responsible for the accuracy of membership numbers, contribution data, invoices, payment markings, and reminders they maintain.
messages.Vereinsverantwortliche wie Owner, Admins: Club administrators, owners, admins, and managers can view and edit their club’s membership, contribution, invoice, and payment data within the scope of their permissions.
messages.Vereinsverwaltungsdaten: Team-Beitrittsa: Club management data: team membership requests, email invitations, external members without an Airmius account, club roles, official club status, club number, membership status, membership number, enrollment date, contribution amount, contribution interval, and club internal membership notes.
messages.Verwaltung von Mitgliedsnummern, Beiträg: Management of membership numbers, contributions, invoices, payment histories, payment statuses, and payment reminders within the scope of the respective club’s responsibilities.
messages.Verwaltung von Team-Beitrittsanfragen, E: Management of team membership requests, invitations, and club memberships by authorized club administrators.
messages.Vor der Anonymisierung wird grundsätzlic: Prior to anonymization, a final notification with a reaction window of approximately 30 days is typically sent. Re-registering resets the inactivity check.
messages.Wartungen, Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und Weit: Maintenance, security measures, and future developments may temporarily restrict functionality.
messages.Weitere lokale Speicherwerte wie Theme,: Additional local storage values such as themes, languages, dashboard layout, or landing page variants are only used for the desired presentation and operation of the platform.
messages.Weitere optionale Anbieter werden erst n: Further optional providers are only activated after explicit naming on this page and with necessary consent.
messages.Welche Daten gelöscht oder anonymisiert: Which data is deleted or anonymized
messages.Wenn du Conversion-Messung erlaubst, kan: If you allow conversion tracking, Airmius can determine whether a lead from an ad contact later results in a registration, inquiry, cart action, order, or payment.
messages.Wenn du dich nicht mehr anmelden kannst,: If you are unable to log in, first use the password reset function. If that is not possible, send your deletion request with the email address of the affected account.
messages.Wenn du personalisierte Werbung erlaubst: If you allow personalized advertising, Airmius can use simple marketplace interests and ad interactions to deliver more relevant ads.
messages.Wenn du stattdessen dein gesamtes Konto: If you instead wish to delete your entire account, log in and open Profile > Account deletion. Confirm your password – or for Google/Microsoft accounts, your account email address – as well as the code sent via email. Your account and associated data will then be removed or, where necessary, anonymized after the account deletion process.
messages.Wenn ein Kind einem Verein oder Team ang: If a child is a member of a club or team, authorized club administrators can manage club-specific membership data and membership/billing information.
messages.Werbe- und Sponsoringdaten: Ads-Kampagne: Advertising and sponsorship data: Ad campaigns, target URLs, budgets, duration, status, impressions, clicks, CTR, and technically required event data for campaign measurement.
messages.Werbeagentur- und Website-Service-Daten:: Marketing agency and website service data: Website requests from clubs, desired domains, goals, notes, offer status, and communication status.
messages.Werbekunden erhalten keine Garantie auf: Marketing customers do not receive guarantees on specific reach, click-throughs, sales, or registrations. Projections and reports are performance indicators, not success guarantees.
messages.Werbekunden müssen sicherstellen, dass Z: Marketing customers must ensure that target pages, images, text, prices, discount information, testimonials, brand rights, and tracking instructions are legally compliant.
messages.Werbekunden und Sponsoren erhalten Auswe: Marketing customers and sponsors receive analytics primarily in aggregated or campaign-specific formats, such as impressions, clicks, budget spend, CTR, status, and conversion metrics. Individual user profiles, names, email addresses, or private communications are not shared as marketing reports with marketing customers.
messages.Werbung und Sponsorinhalte müssen als so: Advertising and sponsorship content must be clearly identifiable as such and must not mislead users.
messages.Zugangsdaten sind geheim zu halten. Nutz: Access credentials must be kept confidential. Users are responsible for activities conducted through their account, to the extent they represent such activities.
messages.Zum Schutz des Kontos können wir vor der: To protect the account, we may request an identity verification before deletion.
messages.Zuordnung von Sportlern und Vereinen übe: Association of athletes and clubs through sports license numbers, club numbers, and membership numbers.
messages.Zur Fristwahrung genügt die rechtzeitige: Timely submission of the withdrawal notice is sufficient for compliance with the deadline.
messages.Öffne in der App Einstellungen > Konto u: Open in the app Settings > Account and Security > Delete account
